title_as_printed: Values of (dv/dP)_{T,x} in Cubic Centimeters per Gram per Atmosphere, Multiplied by -10^4

footnotes_as_printed.x: weight fraction of NaCl in the solution (text under the table); the derivative unit is cubic centimeters per gram atmosphere

property_description: isothermal pressure derivative of specific volume, (dv/dP) at constant T and NaCl weight fraction, measured with a calibrated positive-displacement pump on NaCl solutions; printed as -(dv/dP) x 10^4 cm3/(g atm); mean value over a small pressure change evaluated at the stated pressure
pressure_note: Pressure listed in atm (10, 100, 200, 300); the paper does not say whether gauge or absolute; pressure gauge read in psig ('raised to 5000 p.s.i.g.'), derivative evaluated at the stated pressure; accuracy of gauge +-3 psi

value.what: (dv/dP) at T, x; printed value is -(dv/dP) x 10^4, so value = printed x (-1e-4)

volume_basis_evidence: specific volume per gram of solution
conversion_needs: value is a pressure derivative of specific volume, not a density
notes: Printed as two side-by-side blocks (0, 5, 10 percent left; 15, 20, 25 percent right) with four pressure columns; restacked to one row per measurement (salt-left block first, then right block; temperature order as printed within each salt). Salt percent is printed only on the first row of each 3-row group (and repeated for the 119.4-174.4 C group); filled down. 0.466 etc. printed with a leading zero.
